headline: Nigeria Anti-Graft Agency Settles $2.3 Billion Tax Case With Sterling Oil
summary: The Independent Corrupt Practices Commission withdrew its court case against Sterling Oil Exploration & Energy Production Company following a settlement over an alleged $2.3 billion tax evasion dispute.
why: Sterling Oil is a major upstream producer in Nigeria. Resolving high-value corporate tax investigations clarifies fiscal obligations and removes legal risks in the energy sector.

impacts.why: The withdrawal of court proceedings resolves major legal and tax liability overhangs.
